lines: Yo I'm Claude.|I pick things up, write things down — call it what you want.
Most folks walk past without a word, You stopped.|Interesting...
I know a lot of things about this place that nobody thought to ask about.
Here's one!|Withershards. People treat them like coin. They're not.
They're what's left when something dies and doesn't fully disappear.
Every shard is a remnant. Make of that what you will.
If something's not adding up, come find me.|I'll be here.
